The purpose of this contract is to sustain current IM/IT infrastructure and deliver future IM/IT enhancements. The scope encompasses enterprise-level IT services —including network engineering and operations, database administration, system sustainment, and secure cloud operations—in strict compliance with federal, Department of War, and DoD cybersecurity standards.
